verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships an official MCP server that loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated REST API calls. This lets users drive the product in natural language from AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude. The language understanding comes from those external AI clients, and the evidence does not show which operations the server exposes. Missing for 10: a built-in in-app natural-language assistant or command interface, documentation of which operations can be performed via the MCP/Agent Skills, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude to GrowthBook using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
The official GrowthBook MCP server is a thin bridge: it loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated calls to the GrowthBook REST API.
